title: STRANGE MINUTE #18 · WHAT IF

lines.text: What if you fell into a black hole?
Let's pick the giant at the center of our galaxy.
It weighs as much as four million Suns.
Up close, its gravity bends light like a lens.
To friends watching from a ship, you'd slow down.
Then freeze at the edge. They'd never see you fall in.
But you wouldn't feel a thing as you drift past the event horizon.
From there, not even light can get back out.
Deeper in, gravity pulls your feet harder than your head.
You'd stretch like a noodle. It's called spaghettification.
lines.say: You'd stretch like a noodle. It's called spaghettiffication.

lines.text: And what's at the very center? Nobody knows.
So, would you jump in to find out?
